source_refs.note: Rectangular Components of a Vector: a main subheading of 2.2 Vectors, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 23-23.

blocks.text: A component of a vector is its effective value in a given direction. A vector may be considered as the resultant of its component vectors along the specified directions. It is usually convenient to resolve a vector into its components along the mutually perpendicular directions. Such components are called rectangular components.

Let there be a vector A⃗ represented by a line OP making an angle θ with the x-axis. Draw projection OM of vector A⃗ on x-axis and projection ON of vector A⃗ on y-axis as shown in Fig.2.1. Projection OM being along x-direction represented by A⃗x and projection ON along y-direction is represented by A⃗y. By applying head to tail rule:
